# E-Invoice

Guide for **E-Invoice** APIs in Giddh.

## Authentication

Send `Auth-Key` or `Session-Id`. Base URL: `https://api.giddh.com`.

## Open in API Reference

Full request/response schemas: [E-Invoice](/p/e-invoice?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Endpoints in this module (3)

- [Cancel Einvoice](/p/cancel-einvoice?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Cancel EInvoice For Voucher](/p/cancel-einvoice-for-voucher?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Cancel Einvoice For Account Voucher](/p/cancel-einvoice-for-account-voucher?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Notes

- Prefer endpoint pages for exact query params, body fields, and examples.
- For voucher / business-document flows, pass `voucherVersion=2` when the endpoint documents it.
